spec.studio_prompt: A low-slung Scandinavian modern lounge chair measuring 70 cm wide, 80 cm deep, and 70 cm high. The frame is constructed from warm-toned solid wood in rich brown #77502f and deep chestnut #4f2d19, with exposed organic grain, cylindrical rails, and tapered legs linked by low stretchers. Both the reclined backrest and deep, angled seat feature natural paper cord in sand #a2917c and tan #8d704f, woven into a geometric open grid with tightly wound cord wrapped around the cylindrical wood rails and exposed rounded rail ends.
